items: Hair Salon Toys for Girls- This beauty salon set includes everything girls love about dressing up as a hair stylist. Featuring 58 functional hair styling accessories, this hair salon playset includes Storage Box, Apron, Shawl, Hair Spray, Scissor, Curling Comb, Comb, Curling Iron, Mirror, Hair Dryer, Cards x2, Hair Ribbon X2, Hair Clips x4, Hair Rollers x 8, Perfume, Hair Ties x5, Hair Straighter, Headbands x3, Butterfly Hair Clipsx 10, Hair Extensions, Styling Manu and Fake Money x 10.

Realistic Hair Salon Playset- The included hairdryer produces realistic sounds and blows air, enhancing the overall experience for young children and making their hair-cutting play more engaging and lifelike. ( Note: 2 AAA batteries are required. Not Included). The pretend hair styling set is made of premium ABS plastic, safe and lightweight. Your kids can easily hold and use this hair stylist toy.

My First Styling Toy Set- Encourage your child to role-play as a hairstylist using the different tools and accessories with this beauty salon playset. Children can practice and learn social and emotional skills, such as communication, and problem-solving. Your little stylist can also practice fine motor skills as they explore the functionality of each of the accessories.

Barber Shop Pretend Play- This kids hair salon playset comes with hair styling manu and fake money that are realistic for pretending to be hairdressers and imitating the barber shop experience. Kids can play as stylist and customer in the girl salon, expressing their sparkle with fun hairstyles and colorful looks! Hours of hairstyling fun! This familiarity matters when they have to undergo a real-life haircut.

Great Gift Idea- Accessories in the set are specifically designed with smooth, rounded edges, ensuring comfort for little hands during play. This set is perfect for imaginative play, bonding time, aspiring hairdressers, fun activities or parties, play with dolls, classroom, pretend playtime or hair styling & grooming practice. Gift idea for birthday, holiday, kids' halloween costumes, christmas.
